description: Run your Prefect pipelines: run deployments with parameters, follow and wait for flow runs, cancel, retry and resume them, read their logs, pause deployments, set Variables, and start a workflow when a flow run fails, completes or starts late.

prefect_flow_run_completed_trigger.description: Runs when a flow run completes, of every deployment or the one you choose. Runs that completed before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only runs of this deployment, as flow/deployment. Leave blank for every run.
parameters.name: deployment

parameters.description: Only runs with this tag, such as prod. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: tag

prefect_flow_run_failed_trigger.description: Runs when a flow run fails or crashes, of every deployment or the one you choose, with the error. A run retried and failing again starts it again. Runs that failed before the workflow was turned on don't.

parameters.description: Only runs of this deployment, as flow/deployment. Leave blank for every run.
parameters.name: deployment

parameters.description: Only runs with this tag, such as prod. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: tag

prefect_flow_run_late_trigger.description: Runs when Prefect marks a flow run Late: it was due to start and no worker has started it, such as when the worker is down or the work pool is paused.

parameters.description: Only runs of this deployment, as flow/deployment. Leave blank for every run.
parameters.name: deployment

parameters.description: Only runs with this tag, such as prod. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: tag
